name: Fiberon PET-CF17 @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
All-metal hotend 270 C+ and hardened nozzle. Enclosure not needed (keep door open). Fan OFF. Less moisture sensitive; dryer may be needed in humid climates, store dry. Black; 0.5/1/3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12 (community: HT-PLA).
